function_summary: Pair of DAGU geared DC motors intended to drive small robot wheels.
classification_reason: Locomotion actuators; each motor still needs a wheel or other drive mechanism.
assembly_notes: One catalog unit contains two motors; wheels, chassis, driver, controller and power are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor recommends these motors for Shadow Chassis and explicitly states packs of two.

function_summary: Bipolar NEMA 17 motor providing discrete rotational positioning.
classification_reason: Suggested joint actuator for an arm or small leg concept; vendor sells a general motion-control motor, not a robot limb.
assembly_notes: Requires stepper driver, supply, controller, coupling, mounting and load-appropriate transmission.
evidence_note: Vendor describes 200 steps per revolution, NEMA 17 construction and use with external stepper drivers.

function_summary: Sub-micro hobby servo with limited-angle position control.
classification_reason: Suggested arm joint, with neck or small leg-joint alternatives; requires linkages and suitable loading.
assembly_notes: Includes one servo, several horns and mounting screws; controller, supply and mechanism are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor states actual travel near 160 degrees and lists one servo with horns and screws.

function_summary: Dual TB6612FNG board for independent speed and direction control of two DC motors.
classification_reason: Motor-driving electronics are internal support rather than locomotion hardware themselves.
assembly_notes: Headers are pre-soldered; motors, control signals and power supply are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor describes two motor outputs and pre-soldered male headers.

function_summary: Two-channel DC motor driver controlled through I2C/Qwiic.
classification_reason: Provides electrical motor control; no moving limb or wheel is included.
assembly_notes: Add motors, host controller, Qwiic/wiring and power; logic interface is 3.3 V.
evidence_note: Vendor describes two motor ports, I2C communication, screw terminals and 3.3 V logic.

function_summary: Arduino-compatible development board with a Qwiic peripheral connection.
classification_reason: Programmable internal controller, not a head or structural torso.
assembly_notes: Add program, power and external sensors/actuators; motors need appropriate drivers.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies an Arduino-compatible development board with integrated Qwiic connector.

function_summary: ICM-20948 breakout providing nine-axis motion measurements over Qwiic/I2C.
classification_reason: Orientation and motion sensing is internal support; this is not a camera or distance-sensing head.
assembly_notes: Requires a host board, power, connection and fixed mounting.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies ICM-20948 motion tracking and Digital Motion Processor on a breakout board.

function_summary: VL53L1X time-of-flight breakout for optical distance measurement over I2C/Qwiic.
classification_reason: Forward perception can act as a robot eye; housing and head mechanism are separate.
assembly_notes: Add host board, power, cable and mounting.
evidence_note: Vendor describes laser time-of-flight ranging up to four metres and I2C/Qwiic connectivity.

function_summary: HC-SR04 ultrasonic module with transmitter, receiver and distance-measurement control circuit.
classification_reason: Obstacle ranging makes this a suggested head/eye component; not an entire head assembly.
assembly_notes: Requires 5 V power, host control/wiring and mounting.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies HC-SR04, ultrasonic transmitter/receiver and non-contact ranging.

function_summary: Snap-together ABS frame with mounts for robot electronics and drive hardware.
classification_reason: Primarily the structural torso: drive wheels and motors are not in the listed kit. Secondary legs denotes use as the frame of a separately completed wheeled base.
assembly_notes: Assembly required. Includes plates, mounts, struts, nub caster and 4xAA holder; add motors, drive wheels, batteries and controller.
evidence_note: Vendor kit list includes frame pieces, passive nub caster and battery holder; it says to attach your own motors/controller.

function_summary: Pair of 65 mm rubber-tired wheels for DAGU right-angle gearmotors.
classification_reason: Rolling ground-contact components belong to locomotion; they are unpowered wheels.
assembly_notes: One catalog unit contains two wheels; motors and frame are separate.
evidence_note: Vendor states packs of two and fit for DAGU right-angle gearmotors.

function_summary: Slim rechargeable lithium-ion cell with a JST-PH connection.
classification_reason: Energy source for internal power support, without a standalone body role.
assembly_notes: Battery only; needs compatible charging and any voltage regulation required by the robot.
evidence_note: Vendor identifies 3.7 V nominal, 2000 mAh, JST-PH connector and onboard protection.
